rubrics.justification: Accurately characterizes the image as a day-4 cavitating/early blast rather than an expanded blast, with appropriate caution about poorly defined ICM/TE on a static frame; minor limitation is inability to verify all stated features from the image alone.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian response, BMI, diagnosis, sperm parameters, endometrium, first-cycle status, and day-4 transfer context with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent overall, especially around the image-grade mismatch and prognosis; slight tension exists between calling the case favorable and giving a somewhat conservative implantation range.

Correctly identifies the Gardner grading inconsistency, supports single embryo transfer in a 31-year-old with a good-quality embryo, avoids unnecessary bed rest, and gives evidence-based comments on PGT-A and future workup.

Provides clear practical recommendations for transfer management and future cycle review, including uterine cavity assessment, stimulation review, and embryo development review; could be even more specific on transfer/luteal protocol details.
